crossDomainInvariants.name: Marketplace checkout atomicity
crossDomainInvariants.invariant: Checkout creates canonical marketplace/seller order, fulfillment/reservation/payment allocation/settlement and idempotency records while applying inventory consequences in one SQLite transaction; preserve single commit/replay boundary.
crossDomainInvariants.boundary: Marketplace command coordinates canonical Inventory and Payment records; it must not become a second Inventory or Payment authority.

crossDomainInvariants.name: Marketplace cancellation compensation
crossDomainInvariants.invariant: Cancellation releases reserved stock once and creates canonical Payment refund identity while updating Marketplace projections and lifecycle rows atomically.
crossDomainInvariants.boundary: Marketplace may orchestrate compensation but Payment refund and Inventory movement remain canonical authorities.

crossDomainInvariants.name: Payment financial decision and ledger
crossDomainInvariants.invariant: Financial state, evidence/verification binding, ledger entries, idempotency and marketplace settlement consequences are transactionally coordinated.
crossDomainInvariants.boundary: Payment Core remains sole financial decision/ledger authority; do not split transaction steps by route.

crossDomainInvariants.name: Fulfillment and delivery command lifecycle
crossDomainInvariants.invariant: Fulfillment/delivery commands validate tenant/org/location/courier scope, durable command replay, proof/lifecycle transitions and existing Inventory consequences within their transaction boundaries.
crossDomainInvariants.boundary: Keep the frozen Order → Fulfillment → Delivery Assignment → Delivery Lifecycle → Proof/Exception → Inventory consequence chain; Payment/Settlement stay outside Logistics.

crossDomainInvariants.name: Procurement receipt and Inventory posting
crossDomainInvariants.invariant: Receipt validation binds to approved procurement-origin PO lines and organization location; receipt lines and canonical inventory movements must commit or roll back together, with deterministic event IDs and replay-safe pending state.
crossDomainInvariants.boundary: Procurement owns receipt intent; Inventory owns stock movement. Their transaction contract must be retained as one unit.

crossDomainInvariants.name: Procurement RFQ-time capacity snapshot
crossDomainInvariants.invariant: Supplier capacity evidence is snapshotted at RFQ creation for each invited supplier and persisted with capture time; later evidence changes must not mutate the historical RFQ snapshot.
crossDomainInvariants.boundary: Supplier Network owns source evidence; Procurement owns immutable RFQ-time snapshot. Neither snapshot nor discovery matching authorizes operational scheduling.

crossDomainInvariants.name: Service booking/resource commitment
crossDomainInvariants.invariant: Booking/resource/availability/commitment state shares resource/location scope and idempotent command records; avoid extracting handlers separately from their persistence and scheduling invariant.
crossDomainInvariants.boundary: Service capability owns booking/resource commitments; it does not become a second Logistics Scheduling authority.

mustStayTogether.reason: Shared Marketplace lifecycle, inventory reservations/movements, Payment allocation/refund, settlement and idempotency effects.
Financial decision, ledger, evidence, idempotency, and Marketplace allocation effects are transactionally coupled.
Canonical Inventory ledger is consumed by Procurement, Marketplace and Fulfillment; keep the existing transaction/replay primitive authoritative.
